goodToKnow: Der Europarat is the Council of Europe, founded in 1949 and based in Strasbourg, with 46 member states since Russia's expulsion in 2022. It's not part of the EU; it guards the European Convention on Human Rights through the European Court of Human Rights. Don't confuse it with der Europäische Rat (EU heads of government) or der Rat der EU (EU ministers). It has no plural.
